Package jwat

package jwat
The JWAT tool: workload characterization, as described in the user manual. JWAT imports standard (Apache HTTP, IIS) or customized log formats, analyzes the data with descriptive statistical techniques (means, correlations, histograms, boxplots, scatterplots) and identifies clusters of customers having similar characteristics through k-means and fuzzy k-means clustering.
